title: Session verification and sessionInventory operations each emit one structured audit event on the fixed allow-list
asA: operator running the runtime-verify suite against the Clerk session verifier and its sessionInventory surface
iWant: every verification attempt and every sessionInventory operation to write one structured event carrying only the allow-list fields
soThat: the audit stream stays free of cookie material and every refusal has a stable reasonClass a reviewer can gate on

acceptanceCriteria.description: A completed session verification emits exactly one structured audit event identified by the tuple (`operation=verify`, `outcome=verified`), carrying a session id prefix no longer than eight characters.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an authenticated request carrying a valid `__session` cookie for a Clerk session S1
acceptanceCriteria.when: the session verifier verifies the cookie value
acceptanceCriteria.then: the audit sink records exactly one event whose own-property keys are drawn from `{outcome, operation, reasonClass, sessionIdPrefix, at, principalIdPrefix}` with `outcome=verified` and `operation=verify`; the `__session` cookie value, the full session id, and any raw Clerk claim record are not present in any field; `sessionIdPrefix` is a substring of length no greater than eight characters

acceptanceCriteria.description: A session verification against a `__session` cookie whose Clerk-side expiry has passed emits exactly one audit event identified by the tuple (`operation=verify`, `outcome=refused`) with `reasonClass=expired`; the reasonClass is the single value bound to that input, not one of a set.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a request carrying a `__session` cookie whose Clerk-side expiry has passed
acceptanceCriteria.when: the session verifier verifies the cookie value
acceptanceCriteria.then: the audit sink records exactly one event with `outcome=refused`, `operation=verify`, and `reasonClass=expired`; the event carries `sessionIdPrefix` (no longer than eight characters) and `at`; no cookie value or full session id appears in any field

acceptanceCriteria.description: A sessionInventory operation that first refuses on `unknown_session` and then succeeds on a subsequent call for a valid session id emits exactly one refused event and one verified event, in order; the retry itself is not a distinct event.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an authenticated caller who first calls `sessionInventory.revoke(unknownSessionId)` and then calls `sessionInventory.revoke(validSessionId)`
acceptanceCriteria.when: the two calls run in sequence
acceptanceCriteria.then: the audit sink records exactly two events in order: one with `operation=revoke`, `outcome=refused`, and `reasonClass=unknown_session`, then one with `operation=revoke` and `outcome=verified`; each event carries a `sessionIdPrefix` no longer than eight characters; no full session id or cookie value appears

acceptanceCriteria.description: A sink failure during the emission of a verification audit event does not mask the underlying verification outcome; the mechanism records a `clerk.audit_sink_failed` warning event and the verification outcome is unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a valid `__session` cookie and an audit sink whose write throws
acceptanceCriteria.when: the session verifier emits the completion event
acceptanceCriteria.then: the verification return value still reports the underlying result unchanged (a verified session does not spuriously become unauthenticated, and a refusal does not spuriously become authenticated); the mechanism records a `clerk.audit_sink_failed` warning event carrying `operation` and a reason-class string; no cookie value or full session id appears

acceptanceCriteria.description: An unauthenticated caller invoking a `sessionInventory.revoke(sessionId)` is refused: the audit sink records exactly one event identified by the tuple (`operation=revoke`, `outcome=refused`) with `reasonClass=unauthenticated`; no session state changes on the provider.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a request with no verified session
acceptanceCriteria.then: the audit sink records exactly one event with `outcome=refused`, `operation=revoke`, and `reasonClass=unauthenticated`; the event carries `at`; no session is created, updated or removed on the provider; no cookie value or full session id appears in any field

acceptanceCriteria.description: Verifying the same valid `__session` cookie twice is idempotent: each verify call emits exactly one audit event identified by the tuple (`operation=verify`, `outcome=verified`); two consecutive verifications produce two events (count is one per verify call, never a deduplicated event).
acceptanceCriteria.given: a request carrying a valid `__session` cookie for a Clerk session S1, verified once already
acceptanceCriteria.when: the session verifier verifies the same cookie value a second time
acceptanceCriteria.then: the audit sink records exactly one additional event with `operation=verify` and `outcome=verified`; the total count of verify events across the two attempts is exactly two; each event's `sessionIdPrefix` is a substring of length no greater than eight characters; the verifier's return value is unchanged between calls

description: Applying agent sets: no project-parameterised values on this story; every AC is `fixed`. AC-set sufficiency (7a inline note per blueprint-authoring.md §7a): the credential scenario class is bound by AC-1 (a valid `__session` cookie is the credential and the event records a bounded `sessionIdPrefix`). The permission scenario class is bound by AC-5 (an unauthenticated caller's `sessionInventory.revoke` refuses with `reasonClass=unauthenticated` and no side effect). Events are named by the tuple (`operation`, `outcome`) per REQ-011's allow-list; the blueprint does not carry a top-level `family` field on clerk audit events.
